overview: The Chip-to-Startup (C2S) Programme – VLSI Design Education is a MeitY initiative aimed at fostering VLSI design education and innovation by providing academic and industry collaboration opportunities. It focuses on building capacity in semiconductor design through training, mentorship, and access to EDA tools for students and startups. The programme supports the development of indigenous semiconductor ecosystem by enabling prototype development and productization. It targets academic institutions and startups engaged in VLSI design and related domains.
objectives: Promote VLSI design education and skill development among students and faculty
Enable startups and academic institutions to access EDA tools and design infrastructure
Foster industry-academia collaboration for semiconductor innovation
Support prototype development and productization of VLSI-based solutions
Strengthen India’s semiconductor design ecosystem through mentorship and technical guidance
Encourage indigenous development of semiconductor technologies
Provide platform for testing, validation, and commercialization of chip designs
eligibility: The programme is open to startups, academic institutions, and students engaged in VLSI design, semiconductor research, or related electronics domains. Applicants must be registered entities in India with a focus on innovation in chip design and must demonstrate potential for technology development or commercialization.
benefits: Participants gain access to licensed EDA tools, technical mentorship from industry experts, design review support, prototyping facilities, and opportunities for collaboration with semiconductor companies. The programme also offers guidance on IPR, product development pathways, and linkages to funding and incubation support.
financial_support: The C2S Programme provides non-financial support in the form of EDA tool licenses, technical mentorship, and design infrastructure access. Direct financial grants or subsidies are not explicitly mentioned in the evidence; support is primarily in-kind and technical.
application_process: 1. Visit the official C2S Programme page at https://www.meity.gov.in/c2s 2. Review eligibility and programme guidelines 3. Prepare a proposal outlining VLSI design objectives, team details, and expected outcomes 4. Submit the application through the designated portal or contact point 5. Await evaluation by the programme committee 6. Upon selection, sign MoU and gain access to EDA tools and mentorship 7. Begin design work with periodic reviews and technical support
required_documents: Proposal document detailing VLSI design objectives
Statement of purpose and expected outcomes
Any prior work or prototypes in VLSI design
implementing_agency: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
caveats: Support is primarily non-financial and technical in nature
Continued access to resources is subject to periodic performance review
Intellectual property generated may be subject to programme-specific guidelines
Participation does not guarantee funding or commercialization support
